source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.5 with Figs. 8.7 and 8.8 and Examples 8.2 to 8.4 (PDF 179-183).

blocks.text: Malus ka law kehta hai: analyzer se guzarne ke baad plane polarized light ki intensity I, analyzer aur polarizer ke transmission axes ke darmiyan angle θ ke cosine ke square ke seedha mutabiq (directly proportional) hoti hai. Yani:
jahan I₀ = analyzer par parne wali polarized light ki intensity (polarizer se guzarne ke baad).

Asal mein Malus ka law batata hai ke pehli polaroid (polarizer) par parne wali light ki intensity aur doosri polaroid (analyzer) se guzarne ke baad ki intensity mein kya taalluq hai (Fig. 8.7(a)). Analyzer bhi ek polarizer hi hai jo pehle polarizer ke baad rakha jata hai. Analyzer ko ghumane se polarized light ki intensity badalti hai; is se light ko mazeed kam kiya ja sakta hai aur polarizer ke lihaz se analyzer ka angle badal kar intensity set ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen se daen ek lakeer par: unpolarized light (radial lakeeron ka daira), initial polarizer (khari lakeeron wala kaala disc), I0 intensity wali polarized light (khara dohra teer) aur us ka analyzer ke axis ke mutawazi juz (surmai tirchha teer), analyzer (dhaari-daar disc) jis ka axis khari simt se theta ghooma hai, aur us ke baad I = I0 cos^2 theta wala surmai tirchha teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.7 (a): Malus ke qanoon ka khaaka (kitab ki Figure 8.7 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Polarizer ke baad light vertical simt mein polarized hai (intensity I₀). Analyzer ka axis θ par ghooma hua hai, is liye sirf woh hissa guzarta hai jo analyzer ke axis ke parallel hai. Intensity I = I₀ cos²θ: θ = 0 par poori light, θ = 90° par bilkul nahi.

Kuch shaffaf crystal wale maadde, jaise tourmaline aur calcite, light ki vibration ko sirf ek plane tak mehdood kar sakte hain. Aise maadde polaroids kehlate hain; un ki crystal banawat mein ek khaas simt (directionality) hoti hai. Light qudrati amal, jaise reflection, refraction aur scattering (bikharna), se bhi polarized ho sakti hai.
Agar polarized light ke samne polaroid ka tukra ghumayein to guzarne wali light ki intensity badalti hai. Is ki wajah pehle polarizer aur doosre polarizer ke axis ke darmiyan angle hai.

Jab A₀ amplitude wali polarized light analyzer par angle θ se parti hai to woh do components mein toot jati hai: A₀cosθ aur A₀sinθ (Fig. 8.7(b)). A₀sinθ wala hissa analyzer jazb (absorb) kar leta hai, aur sirf A₀cosθ guzarta hai. Is liye guzarne wali light ka amplitude A:

blocks.alt: Ek nuqte se: plane of polarizer ke saath khara teer A0; us se theta zawiye par plane of analyzer ke saath teer A0 cos theta; aur us ke amudi teer A0 sin theta. Dashed lakeerein mustateel (rectangle) poora karti hain jis ka qutr (diagonal) A0 hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.7 (b): Plane polarized light ke amplitude ko ajza mein taqseem karna (kitab ki Figure 8.7 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: A₀ do hisson mein toot'ta hai: analyzer ke axis ke saath A₀ cos θ (yeh guzarta hai) aur us ke perpendicular A₀ sin θ (yeh absorb ho jata hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 8.7(b) mein dono lakeeron par 'Plane of polarizer' likha hai. Tirchhi lakeer asal mein analyzer ka plane hai, is liye hamari figure mein us par 'Plane of analyzer' likha hai.
Intensity amplitude ka square hoti hai, is liye:
Yahan I₀ analyzer par parne wali polarized light ki intensity hai.
Is equation se θ ki do hadd (extreme) soorten nikalti hain:

items: Agar θ = 0° ho to I = I₀: analyzer se utni hi intensity guzarti hai jitni polarizer se guzri thi.
Agar θ = 90° ho to I = 0: light poori bujh jati hai, analyzer se kuch nahi guzarta.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Crossed (ek doosre se 90° par) polarizers se light nahi guzarti.

blocks.alt: Kai satahon mein lehron aur teeron wali unpolarized beam Polarizer-1 tak aati hai, jo khari jhiriyon wala frame hai. Dono polarizers ke darmiyan sirf khari lehar bachti hai. Polarizer-2, ufuqi jhiriyon wala frame, use rok deta hai.
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 180): Crossed polarizers se guzarti light (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehla polarizer sirf vertical vibration guzarta hai. Doosre ka axis horizontal hai, yani pehle ke perpendicular (crossed); vertical vibration ka horizontal hissa zero hai, is liye aage koi light nahi jati (Malus: θ = 90°, I = 0).
Optical activity
Optical activity kuch maaddon ki woh salahiyat hai jis se woh apne andar se guzarne wali light ka plane of polarization ghuma dete hain. Yeh ghumao polarizer ya analyzer se pakra jata hai (Fig. 8.8).

blocks.alt: Ek shua baen se daen: kai simton mein unpolarized E teer; khare axis wala polarizing filter; khara E; optically active block; khari simt se theta ghooma E; khare axis wala analyzer; aur us ke baad khara E.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.8: Optical activity (kitab ki Figure 8.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Filter ke baad E vertical hai. Optically active maadda (jaise quartz ya cheeni ka mehlool) E ke plane ko θ se ghuma deta hai. Kitab ki figure mein analyzer ka axis vertical hi rakha gaya hai, is liye sirf E ka vertical hissa (E cos θ) guzarta hai, jo chhota dikhaya gaya hai. Analyzer ko bhi θ ghumayein to poora E guzrega; is tarah ghumao ka angle napa jata hai.

Bohat se crystals aur mehlool (solutions) apne andar se guzarne wali light ka plane of polarization ghumate hain; aise maadde optically active kehlate hain. Misalein: quartz crystals, cinnabar (HgS), cheeni wala pani, insulin aur collagen. Ghumao ki miqdar aur simt in baaton par depend karti hai:

items: Maadde ki concentration (mixture ya mehlool ki di hui miqdar mein maadde ki miqdar).
Light us maadde mein kitna faasla tay karti hai.

blocks.text: Optical activity maadde ke molecules ki be-tarteeb (asymmetric) shakal, jaise spring numa (helical), ki wajah se hoti hai. Aise crystal ki sirf chand millimetre motai bhi plane of polarization ko kai degree ghuma deti hai. Kuch organic maadde, jaise cheeni aur tartaric acid, mehlool ki soorat mein light ko ghumate hain. Is khoobi se mehlool mein un ki concentration maloom ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Cheeni ka mehlool aane wali light ke plane of polarization ko ghuma deta hai, to woh horizontal nahi rehta balke angle θ par ho jata hai. Is liye analyzer light ko tab rokta hai jab usay vertical (crossed) position se utna hi ghumaya jaye.

blocks.alt: Unpolarized light (kai simton ke teer) polarizer (halka neela disc) se milti hai, cheeni ke mehlool ki nali (gulabi nali, peela sira) se guzarti hai aur analyzer (halka neela disc) tak pohanchti hai jis par polarized light ka teer khari simt se theta ghooma hai.
blocks.caption: Interesting Information (PDF page 180): Cheeni ka mehlool aane wali light ki plane of polarization ghuma deta hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Example 8.3
blocks.problem: 75 W m⁻² intensity wali polarized light aise analyzer se guzarti hai jis ka axis polarizer ke axis se 30° par hai. Nikalne wali intensity kya hai?
steps: Malus ka law: I = I₀ cos²θ

blocks.title: Do you know?
blocks.text: Do polarizers ko “crossed” (90° par) rakh kar dekhein to bohat kam light guzarti hai.

blocks.title: Example 8.4
blocks.problem: 5 units amplitude wali polarized light aise polarizer (analyzer) se guzarti hai jis ki electric field asal polarization ki simt se 60° par hai. Analyzer se guzarne ke baad wave ka amplitude nikalein.
steps: Amplitude ke liye: A = A₀ cos θ

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Example 8.4 amplitude poochti hai, is liye A = A₀ cos θ lagta hai (cos² nahi). Intensity poochi jaye to I = I₀ cos²θ. Kitab is example mein analyzer ko 'analizer' likhti hai; yeh sirf spelling ki ghalti hai.

blocks.title: Brain Teaser
blocks.text: Unpolarized light ki beam dhund (fog) wali fiza se guzarti hai. Bikhri hui (scattered) light ki polarization kaisi hogi?

blocks.prompt: Brain Teaser: unpolarized light dhund se guzre to bikhri hui (scattered) light ki polarization kaisi hogi?
blocks.explanation: Scattering se light partially polarized ho jati hai: beam ki simt se 90° par bikhri light sab se zyada polarized hoti hai. Dhund ke qatre (droplets) bare hote hain aur light ko kai baar bikherte hain, is liye dhund mein bikhri light sirf thori (partially) polarized hoti hai, saaf asmaan ki light se kam.

blocks.text: Polarization ki ahmiyat
Light ki polarization ki bari ahmiyat in shobon (fields) se zahir hoti hai:
1. Optics aur photonics
Polarized sunglasses, LCD (Liquid Crystal Display) screens aur optical communication systems ke liye polarization zaroori hai.
2. Imaging aur microscopy
Polarization tasveer behtar karti hai: glare (aankh ko pareshan karne wali faltu chamak) kam karti hai aur contrast barhati hai, khaas taur par microscope aur medical imaging mein.
3. Medical istemal
Polarization cancer ki tashkhees (diagnosis), tissue imaging aur laser surgery mein istemal hoti hai, kyun ke is se mukhtalif tissues ko alag pehchana ja sakta hai.
4. Astronomy
Polarization se kaainati waqiaat parhe jate hain, maslan door ke sitaron ki light ki polarization ya cosmic microwave background radiation.
5. Mukhtalif shobe
Polarization ki ahmiyat optics aur photonics, imaging aur microscopy, biology aur chemistry, communication system waghera mein hai.
Polarization ke do bare istemal
Polarizers, jinhein polarizing filters bhi kehte hain, ke do bare istemal hain:
1. Asmaan ki photography
Badalon ki tasveer lene wale camera par polaroid laga hota hai; asmaan se aane wali light polaroid se polarized ho jati hai.

Asmaan ki photography mein polarizers glare aur dhundlahat (haze) kam karte hain, jo fiza ke molecules ke chhote zarron se light ke bikharne (scattering) se paida hoti hai. Polarizers zyada tez safaid light ko rok (block) kar aur baqi rangon ko guzar kar contrast barhate hain, jis se tasveer zyada roshan aur saaf banti hai. (Kitab mein “clocking” chhapa hai; matlab blocking, yani rokna.)

blocks.alt: Kaali sunglasses. Neeli lehrein (highway ke amudi vibrate karti) shishon se guzar jati hain; surkh lehrein (highway ke mutawazi vibrate karti) shishon par ruk jati hain. Neeche do satahon wali unpolarized light beam polarizer sheet se milti hai aur sirf ek lehar, polarized light, nikalti hai.
blocks.caption: Action of polarized sunglasses (PDF page 182): polarizer, unpolarized aur polarized light (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sarak se reflect hone wali chamak (glare) zyada tar sarak ke parallel (horizontal) vibrate karti hai. Polarized sunglasses ka axis vertical hota hai, is liye yeh horizontal vibration rok leti hain aur vertical guzar jati hai: chamak kam, manzar saaf.
2. Materials ka stress analysis
Materials science mein polarizers se plastic, metal aur sheeshe jaise materials par stress aur strain (dabao aur khinchao) jaancha jata hai.

Jab material par stress pare to us ki molecular banawat badalti hai, jis se light ke saath us ka taalluq badalta hai aur fringes (dhaariyon) ki shakal mein interference patterns bante hain, jo material ke bare mein maloomat dete hain. Shaffaf material se polarized light guzar kar aur polarization mein tabdeeli dekh kar mahireen:

items: material mein stress ke patterns maloom kar sakte hain
kamzor hisse ya nuqs (defects) pehchan sakte hain
material ki optical khoobiyan jaanch sakte hain
maloom kar sakte hain ke mukhtalif halaat mein material kaisa rawaiya rakhega. Is tareeqe ko “photoelasticity” kehte hain; yeh engineering, materials science aur quality control mein aam hai.

blocks.text: Dono sooraton mein polarizers light ko qaabu kar ke khaas maqsad hasil karte hain: tasveer behtar karna ya material ki khoobiyan jaanchna.

blocks.caption: Malus ka law ek nazar mein

blocks.prompt: 100 W m⁻² ki polarized beam aise polarizer se guzarti hai jis ka axis 45° par hai; guzarne wali intensity nikalein. 15 W m⁻² ki unpolarized light do polaroids par parti hai jin ke axes vertical se 50° aur 20° par hain; har ek ke baad intensity nikalein. Unpolarized light chaar sheets se guzarti hai, har ek pichhli se 30° ghumi hui; kitne feesad (percent) light nikalti hai (numerical 8.2, 8.5, 8.9)?
blocks.explanation: I = 100 cos² 45° = 50 W m⁻². Pehli sheet unpolarized light ka aadha, 7.5 W m⁻², guzarti hai; dono axes ke darmiyan 30° hai, to doosri 7.5 cos² 30° = 5.6 W m⁻² guzarti hai. Chaar sheets: ½ × (cos² 30°)³ = 0.5 × 0.42 = 0.21, yani 21 percent nikalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Polaroid sunglasses aam sunglasses se behtar kyun hain, aur un ke design mein Malus ka law kaise kaam aata hai (short question 8.1; constructed response 8.3)?
blocks.explanation: Aam rangeen chashme har light ko barabar kam karte hain. Sarak, pani ya gari ke bonnet se reflect hone wali chamak zyada tar satah ke parallel (horizontal) polarized hoti hai. Polaroid lenses ka transmission axis vertical hota hai, to chamak ki vibration aur axis ke darmiyan θ = 90° hai aur Malus ke law se I = I₀ cos² 90° = 0: chamak ruk jati hai jabke baqi manzar nazar aata rehta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Malus ka law: I = I₀ cos²θ (A = A₀ cos θ aur I = A² se); θ = 0° par I₀, θ = 90° par 0.
Optical activity: quartz, cheeni ka mehlool waghera plane of polarization ghumate hain; ghumao maadde, concentration, faasle aur wavelength par depend karta hai.
Istemal: sunglasses, LCD, microscopy, medical, astronomy; sky photography aur stress analysis (photoelasticity).
